### Crying Out for Help
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-march-31-2024.html
Passage: Judges 6:3, 6
Points:
- Israel repeatedly fell into sin, leading to devastating oppression that left them utterly helpless.
- Believers are often best positioned to learn genuine faith when brought to the end of their self-sufficiency.
- God does not promise immediate ease, often guiding His people through hardship and patient waiting.
- God uses affliction and His word to convict believers and draw them into communion with Himself.
- Though judgment is deserved, God in His grace responds with mercy and the promise of His presence.
